surfaces.agentGuidance: Discord's REST API v10 — guilds, channels, messages, members, and bot/webhook operations.
notes: base https://discord.com/api/v10 (verified 2026-07-10, method file docs/methods/30.13-curated-catalog-expansion.md §0b) — prefer the stable, versioned http surface over Discord's own OpenAPI doc, which self-labels "(Preview)" upstream. via:"descriptor" (http surface convention, mirrors github's http surface) with credential.kind:"bearer" — the existing discord oauth2 provider (packages/core/src/oauth/catalog.ts) mints an OAuth2 bearer token; a bot token is also accepted via mode:"token".
